facts.fact: INACOM says its relaunched portal now has a 24-hour chatbot with artificial intelligence that answers questions and tracks the status of processes.

AGO.note: The AI chatbot is for general administration, not a sector's public system.
Document does not say the AI is built or hosted in the country.
Portal relaunch names no count of online services or transactions.
